Because the material moves with the leg as it warms rather than staying rigid, players tend to forget it is there, which is exactly the point. On a team level it is also one of the simplest ways to keep a squad looking uniform, with tape colour matched across the whole side.

Fewer stoppages to pull socks up, shin pads that stay put, and a tidier, more consistent look across the team. Applying it takes seconds in the changing room and removing it afterwards is just as quick, so it slots into a matchday routine without adding another job to it.

name: LiveLica Level 4 Cut Resistant Ankle Socks for Short Track Speed Skating
lines: The LiveLica Cut Resistant Ankle Socks add a dedicated layer of protection to one of the most exposed parts of a short track skater's body. In the pack, blades pass low and close to the ice, and the ankle sits right in the firing line. These socks put certified cut resistant fabric exactly where you need it, for training and for racing.

The socks are made from a cut resistant fabric and are labelled to the EN388 standard at cut resistance level 4, which is a high band of cut protection. In plain terms, the fabric resists a passing blade far better than an ordinary sock, lowering the risk of a serious cut to the ankle. Most short track competitions expect cut resistant clothing, and dedicated ankle protection is a sensible part of a complete race kit.

Your ankle is one of the areas short track skaters expose most, especially in a fall or a pack pile up where other blades come close. These socks wrap the ankle and lower shin in cut resistant fabric, so you are covered in exactly the spot a race suit and boot can leave open.
a silicone band at the top holds the sock in place so it does not slide down mid session
one size, made to fit a wide range of skaters
The one size design and silicone gripper mean they stay put on the ankle through crossovers, starts and hard corners. They pull on under your race suit and over your boot line as you prefer.

Rinse off ice and grit after sessions, wash gently and dry flat away from direct heat. Avoid harsh detergents and tumble drying, which can shorten the life of the protective fibres and the silicone gripper.
What does cut resistance level 4 mean?
It is a high band of cut protection under the EN388 standard. The fabric resists a slicing edge far better than an ordinary sock, which is what you want around an exposed ankle in short track.
One size, designed to fit a wide range of skaters, held in place by a silicone gripper band. If you have any doubt about fit, message us.
Do they come as a pair?
Yes, they are supplied as a pair.
Do I still need a cut resistant undersuit?
These socks protect the ankle specifically. For full body protection, pair them with our

LiveLica Level 4 Cut Resistant Ankle Socks for Short Track Speed Skating
lines: The LiveLica Cut Resistant Ankle Socks add a dedicated layer of protection to one of the most exposed parts of a short track skater's body. In the pack, blades pass low and close to the ice, and the ankle sits right in the firing line. These socks put certified cut resistant fabric exactly where you need it, for training and for racing.

The socks are made from a cut resistant fabric and are labelled to the EN388 standard at cut resistance level 4, which is a high band of cut protection. In plain terms, the fabric resists a passing blade far better than an ordinary sock, lowering the risk of a serious cut to the ankle. Most short track competitions expect cut resistant clothing, and dedicated ankle protection is a sensible part of a complete race kit.

Your ankle is one of the areas short track skaters expose most, especially in a fall or a pack pile up where other blades come close. These socks wrap the ankle and lower shin in cut resistant fabric, so you are covered in exactly the spot a race suit and boot can leave open.
a silicone band at the top holds the sock in place so it does not slide down mid session
one size, made to fit a wide range of skaters
The one size design and silicone gripper mean they stay put on the ankle through crossovers, starts and hard corners. They pull on under your race suit and over your boot line as you prefer.

Rinse off ice and grit after sessions, wash gently and dry flat away from direct heat. Avoid harsh detergents and tumble drying, which can shorten the life of the protective fibres and the silicone gripper.
What does cut resistance level 4 mean?
It is a high band of cut protection under the EN388 standard. The fabric resists a slicing edge far better than an ordinary sock, which is what you want around an exposed ankle in short track.

Do they come as a pair?
Yes, they are supplied as a pair.
